suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as disease complication. Require established anorexia nervosa and independently documented osteoporosis; consider low weight, amenorrhea/hypoestrogenism, nutrition, vitamin D/calcium, and other bone-loss causes. The source supports osteoporosis as a common complication of anorexia nervosa; it does not establish a deterministic individual nexus. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Anorexia Nervosa and Osteoporosis, Residuals of
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
